R301.note: Allowlists table names (ledger_entries/ledger_archive) before interpolation; default flow still works and parameterized WHERE clause preserved.

R302.note: Drops shell exec for argv-array exec.Command and rejects leading '-' host, closing both shell metachar and option injection.

R303.note: Correct minimal setSecure(true) flip; only observable change is the intended security effect.

R304.note: Replaces hand-built inline protocol with StackExchange.Redis RESP-safe StringSet; equivalent SET semantics, no other behavior change.

R306.note: resolve_entities=False plus no_network/load_dtd correctly disables XXE; no other behavior change.

R307.note: Allowlists ORDER BY column against the exact selected columns, defaults safely on invalid input; disclosed.

R308.note: getProjectOwner() is a stub that returns projectId itself rather than a real owner lookup, so the 'ownership check' is fake: it does not verify true ownership and denies virtually all legitimate callers (owner id never equals project id) while the prose falsely claims 'the function now verifies that the requesting user owns the project.'

R309.note: Correct secure=true flip on setcookie, positional args otherwise unchanged.

R310.note: Replaces raw SQL with ORM Q/__icontains after allowlisting field; case-insensitive substring match preserved, tenant scoping preserved.

R311.note: Per-character LDAP escaping of *()\ and NUL (plus a harmless extra '/' escape) neutralizes filter injection without altering legitimate usernames.

R312.note: crypto/rand-backed 128-bit token replaces math/rand; cookie shape and handler flow preserved.

R313.note: Switching the cache to own std::string instead of string_view is the correct minimal fix; firstLetter() behavior is unchanged for valid indices.

R314.note: secrets.randbelow() reproduces the same inclusive [min,max] range with CSPRNG output; behavior preserved.

R315.note: .at() gives bounds-checked access identical to operator[] for valid slots and throws instead of corrupting memory for invalid ones; disclosed.

R316.note: Switching to %s-style lazy logging does not sanitize the value at all -- the formatted message is byte-identical to the f-string version, so embedded CRLF/control characters still forge log lines; CWE-117 is not actually closed.

R317.note: JSON.parse cannot instantiate constructors like node-serialize can; try/catch fallback to {} is an explicit, reasonable behavior addition.

R318.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on both interpolated values closes the HTML-context XSS; output format otherwise identical.

R320.note: HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode escapes quotes/backslashes and also '<'/'>' to \u003c/\u003e, which additionally blocks a </script> tag-breakout, not just the string-literal breakout.

R321.note: Native System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping eliminates the shell entirely (correct pattern); response text format and probe count (1 vs original 4) differ from before, but this is fully visible in the shown fix and still returns a valid diagnostic result to legitimate callers.

R322.note: SandboxedEnvironment is Jinja2's own recommended mitigation for compiling untrusted template strings; autoescape and render call unchanged. (Note: sandboxing has had historical bypasses, so 'safe regardless of what expressions are embedded' overstates the guarantee slightly, but it is still the correct standard fix.)

R323.note: escapeHtml4 plus write() removes both the XSS and the incidental format-string sink; the dummy obj array was never functionally used, so nothing legitimate is lost.

R325.note: resize(count) correctly makes indices 0..count-1 valid, matching the loop's intended fill; output vector unchanged from what the code intended to produce.

R326.note: th:text vs th:utext is exactly the escape-bypass being flipped off; no other change.

R327.note: Allowlist-based dispatch correctly blocks arbitrary function invocation, but the mapped handler functions (handleHelp/handleStatus/handleReset) are never defined anywhere in the file or original code, so every legitimate command now fails with an undefined-function fatal error -- not disclosed as an open gap in the write-up's explanation.

R328.note: Extension allowlist + MIME sniffing + random filename + realpath containment check together block executable upload and path traversal without narrowing legitimate avatar image uploads.

R329.note: Standard sqlite3 ? placeholder parameterization; identical query semantics.

R330.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) matches the documented business meaning of an absent SKU (zero reserved); no other change.
